deposit_accounting.bucket_intro: The accounting reconstruction groups the non-TDC deposit component into four buckets.

definitions: Interpretive proxy bucket `deposit_substitution_block_qoq`, constructed as `large_time_deposits_qoq - retail_mmf_assets_qoq - institutional_mmf_assets_qoq`.
Large time deposits: outcome `large_time_deposits_qoq`, FRED `LTDACBM027NBOG`, quarter-over-quarter change.
Retail money market fund assets: outcome `retail_mmf_assets_qoq`, FRED `RMFSL`, quarter-over-quarter change.
Institutional money market fund assets: outcome `institutional_mmf_assets_qoq`, FRED `WIMFSL` with Z.1 fallback `BOGZ1FL883034010Q`, quarter-over-quarter change.
buckets.equation_html: ΔDsubt = ΔLTDt - ΔMMFretailt - ΔMMFinstt
series: Retail money market fund assets (`retail_mmf_assets_qoq`; FRED `RMFSL`)
Institutional money market fund assets (`institutional_mmf_assets_qoq`; FRED `WIMFSL`, fallback `BOGZ1FL883034010Q`)
buckets.summary: This bucket asks whether money moves between deposits and deposit-like instruments rather than disappearing outright.
buckets.title: Deposit substitution

definitions: Interpretive proxy bucket `bank_balance_sheet_proxy_block_qoq`, constructed as `bank_non_treasury_securities_qoq + bank_short_term_loans_z1_qoq`.
Banks' non-Treasury securities: outcome `bank_non_treasury_securities_qoq`, FRED `OSEACBW027SBOG`, quarter-over-quarter change.
Short-term bank loans: outcome `bank_short_term_loans_z1_qoq`, FRED `BOGZ1FL704041005Q`, quarter-over-quarter change.
buckets.equation_html: ΔDbankt = ΔSbank, non-Tsyt + ΔLbank, shortt
buckets.summary: This bucket tracks the other bank asset moves that can create or absorb deposits outside the direct Treasury channel.
buckets.title: Bank balance-sheet adjustment

definitions: Interpretive proxy bucket `public_liquidity_proxy_block_qoq`, constructed as `- tga_balance_qoq - on_rrp_balance_qoq`.
Treasury General Account balance: outcome `tga_balance_qoq`, FRED `WDTGAL`, quarter-over-quarter change.
ON RRP balance: outcome `on_rrp_balance_qoq`, FRED `RRPONTSYD`, quarter-over-quarter change.
buckets.equation_html: ΔDpublict = - ΔTGAt - ΔONRRPt
buckets.summary: This bucket tracks public cash balances that pull money into or out of the private deposit base.
buckets.title: Public-liquidity plumbing

definitions: Interpretive proxy bucket `external_flow_proxy_block_qoq`, constructed as `row_private_flow_block + net_exports_qoq`.
Rest-of-world private-flow block: outcome `row_private_flow_block`, constructed as `row_corp_bonds_flow + row_corp_equities_flow + row_agency_flow + row_nonfin_business_loans_flow`.
Net exports: outcome `net_exports_qoq`, constructed as `exports_qoq - imports_qoq`, using FRED `EXPGS` and `IMPGS`.
buckets.equation_html: ΔDextt = ΔFROW, privatet + ΔNXt
series: ROW private-flow block (`row_private_flow_block` = `row_corp_bonds_flow + row_corp_equities_flow + row_agency_flow + row_nonfin_business_loans_flow`)
buckets.summary: This bucket tracks cross-border and external-balance channels that can add to or subtract from deposits.
buckets.title: External flow

deposit_accounting.gap_equation_html: ΔDgapt = ΔDnon-TDCt - ΔDrecont
identity_definitions: Reconstruction outcome `accounting_identity_total_qoq`, defined as `accounting_deposit_substitution_qoq + accounting_bank_balance_sheet_qoq + accounting_public_liquidity_qoq + accounting_external_flow_qoq`.
Deposit-substitution accounting channel `accounting_deposit_substitution_qoq`; the bucket card below shows the proxy construction `deposit_substitution_block_qoq`.
Bank balance-sheet accounting channel `accounting_bank_balance_sheet_qoq`; the bucket card below shows the proxy construction `bank_balance_sheet_proxy_block_qoq`.
Public-liquidity accounting channel `accounting_public_liquidity_qoq`; the bucket card below shows the proxy construction `public_liquidity_proxy_block_qoq`.
External-flow accounting channel `accounting_external_flow_qoq`; the bucket card below shows the proxy construction `external_flow_proxy_block_qoq`.
deposit_accounting.identity_equation_html: ΔDrecont = ΔDsubt + ΔDbankt + ΔDpublict + ΔDextt
deposit_accounting.impact_summary: On impact, the non-TDC deposit component falls by -0.61, the accounting reconstruction moves by -0.59, the remaining gap is -0.02.
residual_definitions: Residual outcome `other_component_qoq`, constructed in the quarterly design as `matched_total_deposits - tdc_bank_only_qoq`.
Observed matched deposits outcome `matched_total_deposits`, quarter-over-quarter change in FRED `BOGZ1FL764100005Q`.
Baseline TDC treatment `tdc_bank_only_qoq`, mapped from the treatment source `tdc_base_bank_only_ru_flow` in the `tdcest` bundle.
deposit_accounting.residual_equation_html: ΔDnon-TDCt = ΔDmatchedt - ΔDTDCt
deposit_accounting.subtitle: The residual deposit component and the accounting reconstruction move together rather than in opposite directions.
deposit_accounting.summary: The quarterly deposit result has two parts. Matched deposits rise with TDC, while the non-TDC deposit component moves the other way. The accounting reconstruction checks whether that second piece can be rebuilt from deposit substitution, bank balance-sheet adjustment, public-liquidity plumbing, and external flows.
deposit_accounting.title: Deposits and the accounting reconstruction tell the same story

insights.body: The baseline reduced-form work asks whether the Treasury component of deposits first shows up in deposits before it shows up anywhere else.
insights.title: Where does Treasury financing show up first?

insights.body: The main perimeter check asks whether the deposit result survives when the TDC construction broadens from the baseline bank-focused measure to a broader depository-holder definition.
insights.title: Does the deposit result survive broader holder definitions?

insights.body: The accounting check asks whether the residual deposit component can be rebuilt from deposit substitution, bank balance-sheet adjustment, public-liquidity plumbing, and external flows.
insights.title: Can the non-TDC deposit component be reconstructed?

baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.branch_note: Selected public version uses the expanded control set built from a screened pool of K=100 lagged indicators.
baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.subtitle: The selected public branch does not support an early credit-spread headline.
baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.summary: Credit measures remain a cross-check, not a lead result. The current public branch does not show a robust early spread response, so this stays in additional evidence.
baseline_tdc_lp_credit_spreads.title: Credit spreads remain secondary evidence

baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.branch_note: Selected public version uses the expanded control set built from a screened pool of K=200 lagged indicators.
baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.subtitle: Matched deposits rise on impact while another deposit component leans against them.
baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.summary: The cleanest current transmission result is deposit-side. The baseline TDC estimate raises matched deposits early, but another deposit component moves the other way, which looks more like balance-sheet reallocation than uniform expansion.
baseline_tdc_lp_deposits.title: Deposits reallocate first

baseline_tdc_lp_fx.branch_note: Selected public version uses the expanded control set built from a screened pool of K=100 lagged indicators.
baseline_tdc_lp_fx.subtitle: The broad-dollar branch is directional, not decisive.
baseline_tdc_lp_fx.summary: The broad-dollar branch points toward near-term softening, but it is still a one-series supporting check rather than a headline result.
baseline_tdc_lp_fx.title: FX evidence stays modest

baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.branch_note: Selected public version uses the expanded control set built from a screened pool of K=100 lagged indicators.
baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.subtitle: Any inflation signal is later and less secure than the deposit result.
baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.summary: Inflation is not part of the headline claim stack. At most, the current branch suggests a later and mixed pattern, with somewhat more movement in core measures than in headline CPI.
baseline_tdc_lp_inflation.title: Inflation remains a secondary branch

baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.branch_note: Selected public version uses the expanded control set built from a screened pool of K=100 lagged indicators.
baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.subtitle: Category shifts matter more than a single expansion story.
baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.summary: The private-asset block is a composition check, not a settled mechanism result. It looks across non-Treasury bank securities and lending categories to see where any crowd-out might appear.
baseline_tdc_lp_private_assets.title: Private-asset responses look mixed

tdc_state_dep_low_reserves.branch_note: Selected public version uses the expanded control set built from a screened pool of K=200 lagged indicators.
tdc_state_dep_low_reserves.subtitle: This is the only public heterogeneity check still left on the site.
tdc_state_dep_low_reserves.summary: The low-reserve branch is still only supporting evidence. It is kept as a suggestive heterogeneity check, not as a headline mechanism result.
tdc_state_dep_low_reserves.title: State dependence under low-reserve conditions

insights.title: FX tracks the external pricing margin
